title: Chapter 14 — Collation Night
description: The boxes are counted. The sheets travel to the collation centre. Between the two, numbers can change their minds.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Before the sheets travel: at the Market polling unit, your agent fainted from the heat at 4 p.m. You sit in his chair at the counting table yourself.

won.toast: Every agent signs the Market sheet: clean, counted, photographed. Ifeoma's camera got all of it.

lost.toast: The nephew's agent disputes your pile. The sheet goes to collation with a big question mark on it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The collation centre is the primary school on South Street. Your agents phone in the polling unit results one by one: Front Stop, Market, Motor Park, and six others.

beats.speaker: seyi
beats.text: (holding three phones) Our sheets say we're ahead by four thousand. The nephew's sheets say he's ahead by two thousand. Both sheets have stamps. Somebody's stamp is lying.

beats.speaker: mrAdjust
beats.text: (passing you in the corridor, without stopping) Everything is fluctuating nicely, sir. Very nicely.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Midnight. A white Hiace with no number plate stops behind the school. Two men carry ballot sheets in from the back door, not the front.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: Your agents are watching you to see what you do.

options.text: Block the back door with your agents. Film everything.
Call the police commissioner's line. Let them deal with it.
Let it go. Your own sheets will be enough.

won.toast: The van leaves without unloading. Your agents sing the national anthem at the back door, badly.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: 3 a.m. A message from the nephew's camp, through Seyi: they will accept a "power-sharing arrangement". The nephew is declared winner. You become Deputy Leader of the council, with an office, a car and a budget line. Everybody goes home happy.

beats.speaker: seyi
beats.text: They're offering because they're frightened, Teacher. The van went home empty. That means they're losing.

beats.speaker: seyi
beats.text: Seyi is not telling you what to do. For once.

options.text: "No deals. Let the returning officer read what the people wrote."
Accept the deal. Deputy is something. Deputy is safe.

beats.title: Collation Night
beats.summary: You guarded the sheets, or watched them change. At dawn the returning officer clears his throat.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: At dawn the nephew is declared winner. At noon you are announced as Deputy Leader of the council. At four o'clock the nephew's people take the market toilet key, the one Mama Titi brought, "for safekeeping".

beats.speaker: mamaTiti
beats.text: (at your new office door, not coming in) Deputy. (She says it the way you say a disease.) We voted for a teacher. We got a deputy.

beats.title: The Deputy
beats.summary: You shared power with the people who stole it. You have an office. The market has a padlock.

beats.speaker: mamaTiti
beats.text: (who has somehow got into the collation centre with a flask of tea) Deputy? (She pours you a cup.) Teacher, the women did not stand in the sun all day for a deputy. Drink your tea and think properly.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: The nephew's man is waiting for an answer.

options.text: "No deal. Let the officer read what the people wrote."

beats.title: Collation Night
beats.summary: You guarded the sheets, or watched them change. At dawn the returning officer clears his throat.
